newsitem.title: RUSSIA: At least 27 dead in Russian explosion--agency.
newsitem.headline: At least 27 dead in Russian explosion--agency.

text.p: At least 27 people were killed and dozens more trapped in the wreckage after an explosion destroyed part of a building housing Russian military officers on Saturday, RIA news agency said.
Itar-Tass news agency put the latest death toll at 23. The explosion ripped through much of the eight-storey building in the southern republic of Dagestan early on Saturday.
RIA said 27 bodies had so far been dragged from the building, where it said more than 130 people lived. Among the casualties was a small child, who died after being taken to hospital.

Earlier a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Emergency Situations in Moscow said 54 people had been pulled from the rubble of the building, located in the town of Kaspiysk. Some 45 were still trapped, she added.
She declined to comment on the cause of the explosion but Tass, quoting Russian border guard forces, said an explosive device appeared to have gone off.
